sources.title: Inside fake-to-true gap: n = 4 search, family and field-equation bound
sources.citation: research/inside_gap_n4_20261102/PROTOCOL.md (frozen; Amendments 1-2), inside_gap_n4.rs, family_n8.rs, independent_falls.py, results/, and papers/ic-negative-results/lean/IcNegative/InsideGap.lean.

nodes.label: {XYW+XY+W, XZW+XW+1}: d_F(inside) = 4, d'_F = 1
nodes.statement: Over F_2 in four variables, F = {XYW + XY + W, XZW + XW + 1} has d'_F = 1 and, with the field equations inside, d_F = 4: gap 3, the maximum possible for n >= 2.
nodes.scope: Found in the Q3 sample (multilinear degree <= 3, n = 4); exact, two independent implementations (Rust census, Python linear algebra). Four variables: outside the two-variable Lean encoding.

nodes.label: n = 1: {X^k, X^k+1} has inside gap k - 1
nodes.statement: In one variable over F_2, F = {X^k, X^k + 1} (k >= 2): X + (X + 1) = 1 is a fake fall at 1, and with the field equation inside X^k + (X^k + 1) = 1 is a true fall at k, with none below (only X^2 + X is admissible below k, and one generator never falls). So d_F(inside) - d'_F = k - 1.
nodes.scope: Hand proof; checked k = 2..8 by both implementations. The only unbounded case: with two or more variables the field equations alone fall at 4.

nodes.label: Inside gap census n = 2, 3, 4: maxima 1, 2, 3
nodes.statement: Exact inside-gap census (d_F(inside) - d'_F, cap 6): all pairs of degree <= 2 with n = 2 (1,891) max 1; n = 3 (521,731) max 2; n = 4 multilinear degree <= 2 exhaustive (2,092,035) max 2; n = 4 degree <= 2 sample (2,000,000) max 2; n = 4 multilinear degree <= 3 sample (2,000,000) max 3 (592 pairs). No undetermined system.
nodes.scope: Pairs only. The maximum 3 meets the proved bound for n >= 2.

edges.statement: Attains the bound 3, so it is tight.
With one variable there is no field-equation fall at 4 and the gap is unbounded.

Under the equality reading with the field equations inside, d_F <= 4 for every system in n >= 2 variables: the inside placement measures nothing beyond 4 unless trivial field-equation falls are excluded.
In the inside placement Lemma 4 can only fail when d'_F < 4, since d_F <= 4 always (n >= 2).
